<!doctype html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>তারাগঞ্জ ওয়াক্ফ এস্টেট সরকারি কলেজ, রংপুর</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 viewBox=%270 0 100 100%27%3E%3Ctext y=%27.9em%27 font-size=%2790%27%3E%F0%9F%8F%AB%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Tiro+Bangla&display=swap">
<style id="app-css">:root{
  --bg:#EAF0EA; --panel:#FFFFFF; --ink:#15221B; --muted:#56675D; --line:#CFDAD1; --soft:#F2F7F2;
  --brand:#1D5C43; --brand-deep:#123B2C; --on-brand:#F4FAF6; --accent:#E2A72E; --on-accent:#2A1F04;
  --alert:#B8322A; --link:#17694B; --focus:#1B6FD1; --ok:#17694B;
  --serif:'Tiro Bangla','Noto Serif Bengali','Kalpurush',Georgia,serif;
  --sans:'Hind Siliguri','Noto Sans Bengali','Kalpurush','SolaimanLipi',system-ui,sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#0D1410; --panel:#151F1A; --ink:#E4EDE7; --muted:#9DB0A5; --line:#263630; --soft:#1A2721;
    --brand:#226A4E; --brand-deep:#0B2A1F; --link:#7FD3A9; --ok:#7FD3A9; --alert:#D2554B;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0D1410; --panel:#151F1A; --ink:#E4EDE7; --muted:#9DB0A5; --line:#263630; --soft:#1A2721;
  --brand:#226A4E; --brand-deep:#0B2A1F; --link:#7FD3A9; --ok:#7FD3A9; --alert:#D2554B;
}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 56px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.7;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
a{color:var(--link)}
img{max-width:100%}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);padding:.5rem 1rem;z-index:200}
.skip:focus{left:0}

/* ---------- masthead ---------- */
.masthead{position:relative;background:var(--brand-deep);color:var(--on-brand);padding:1.7rem 1rem 1.5rem;overflow:hidden}
.masthead::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2272%22%20height%3D%2272%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2072%2072%22%3E%3Cg%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23fff%22%20stroke-opacity%3D%22.09%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.3%22%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M36%206%20L50%2022%20L36%2038%20L22%2022%20Z%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M36%2034%20L50%2050%20L36%2066%20L22%2050%20Z%22%2F%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2236%22%20cy%3D%2236%22%20r%3D%223.5%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M0%2036%20H16%20M56%2036%20H72%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fg%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E");opacity:1;pointer-events:none}
.masthead-inner{position:relative;max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1.3rem;text-align:left}
.masthead a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.logo{flex:none;width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.logo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.school-name{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,5.4vw,3.9rem);line-height:1.22;margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
.tagline{margin:.45rem 0 0;font-size:clamp(.88rem,1.9vw,1.05rem);opacity:.88}
.paar{height:12px;background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%2224%22%20height%3D%2212%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2024%2012%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%2224%22%20height%3D%2212%22%20fill%3D%22%23B8322A%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M0%2012%20L12%201%20L24%2012%20Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23F4F0E4%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M12%204%20L15.5%209%20L8.5%209%20Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23E2A72E%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E") repeat-x 0 0/24px 12px}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .masthead{padding:1.1rem .9rem 1rem}
  .masthead-inner{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:.6rem}
  .logo{width:64px;height:64px;font-size:1.9rem}
}

/* ---------- ticker ---------- */
.ticker{display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);overflow:hidden}
.ticker-label{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.45rem 1rem;background:var(--alert);color:#fff;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker-view{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.ticker-move{display:inline-flex;white-space:nowrap;padding:.45rem 0;animation:tick var(--dur,40s) linear infinite}
.ticker-set{display:inline-flex;flex:none;min-width:100vw}
.ticker-view:hover .ticker-move,.ticker-view:focus-within .ticker-move{animation-play-state:paused}
.ticker-item{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;padding:0 0 0 1.6rem;font-weight:500}
.ticker-item::after{content:"◆";margin-left:1.6rem;font-size:.6em;opacity:.55;vertical-align:middle}
.ticker-item:hover{text-decoration:underline}
@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ticker-move{animation:none}.ticker-view{overflow-x:auto}}

/* ---------- menu ---------- */
.menu{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:30;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.menu-inner{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto}
.menu ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu>.menu-inner>ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.menu li{position:relative}
.menu a,.menu .mi{display:block;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font:inherit;font-weight:500;font-size:.97rem;padding:.7rem .8rem;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.5}
.menu a:hover,.menu .mi:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.menu a.on,.menu li.on>.mi{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--accent)}
.menu a.apply{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:600;margin:.3rem .3rem}
.menu a.apply:hover{background:#F0B93F}
.has-sub>.mi::after{content:"";display:inline-block;margin-left:.45rem;border:4px solid transparent;border-top-color:currentColor;border-bottom:0;vertical-align:middle}
.sub{display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:100%;min-width:230px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);z-index:40;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.has-sub.open>.sub{display:block}
.sub a{color:var(--ink);padding:.6rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sub a:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.menu-toggle{display:none;width:100%;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font:inherit;font-weight:600;padding:.75rem 1rem;cursor:pointer}
.burger,.burger::before,.burger::after{display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:#fff;position:relative;content:""}
.burger::before{position:absolute;top:-6px}.burger::after{position:absolute;top:6px}
@media (max-width:899px){
  .menu-toggle{display:flex}
  .menu>.menu-inner>ul{display:none;flex-direction:column}
  .menu.open>.menu-inner>ul{display:flex}
  .menu a,.menu .mi{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:.75rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
  .menu a.apply{margin:.5rem 1rem;width:auto;text-align:center}
  .sub{position:static;box-shadow:none;border:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  .sub a{color:#fff;border-bottom:0;padding-left:2rem}
  .sub a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:1rem}
.layout{display:grid;gap:1rem;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"main" "left" "right"}
.col-main{grid-area:main;min-width:0}
.col-left{grid-area:left}.col-right{grid-area:right}
.col-left,.col-right{display:grid;gap:1rem;align-content:start;min-width:0}
@media (min-width:720px){.layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"main main" "left right"}}
@media (min-width:1080px){.layout{grid-template-columns:264px minmax(0,1fr) 290px;grid-template-areas:"left main right"}}
.stack{display:grid;gap:1rem}

.page{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:1.2rem clamp(1rem,3vw,1.8rem)}
.page h1{font:400 clamp(1.4rem,3vw,1.9rem)/1.35 var(--serif);margin:0 0 1rem;padding-bottom:.55rem;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent)}
.page p{margin:0 0 .9rem}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.empty{color:var(--muted);padding:.5rem 0}
.back{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:.8rem}

.widget{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.widget>h2{margin:0;padding:.55rem .9rem;font:400 1.15rem/1.4 var(--serif);border-left:5px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft)}
.wb{padding:.9rem}

.btn{display:inline-block;font:inherit;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--brand);border-radius:3px;padding:.45rem 1rem;line-height:1.5}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--link);border-color:var(--link)}
.btn.warn{background:var(--alert);border-color:var(--alert)}
.btn.small{padding:.2rem .65rem;font-size:.9rem}
.btn.big{padding:.7rem 1.4rem;font-size:1.05rem;background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:600}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.55;cursor:default}

/* ---------- slider ---------- */
.slider{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--brand-deep);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;aspect-ratio:16/7;min-height:190px;touch-action:pan-y}
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .7s ease,visibility .7s}
.slide.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;z-index:1}
.slide>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.slide.ph{background:var(--ph,#1D5C43)}
.slide.ph.v0{--ph:#1D5C43}.slide.ph.v1{--ph:#7C2D2A}.slide.ph.v2{--ph:#23406B}
.slide.ph::before,.tile.ph::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%22200%22%20height%3D%22200%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20200%20200%22%3E%3Cg%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke%3D%22%23fff%22%20stroke-opacity%3D%22.16%22%20stroke-width%3D%221.6%22%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%22100%22%20r%3D%2218%22%2F%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%22100%22%20r%3D%2240%22%2F%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%22100%22%20r%3D%2262%22%2F%3E%3Cg%20id%3D%22p%22%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fg%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(45%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(90%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(135%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(180%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(225%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(270%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3Cellipse%20cx%3D%22100%22%20cy%3D%2256%22%20rx%3D%229%22%20ry%3D%2220%22%20transform%3D%22rotate(315%20100%20100)%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fg%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E")}
.cap{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;max-width:min(600px,92%);background:rgba(10,36,27,.86);color:#fff;padding:.75rem 1.1rem 1rem;display:grid;gap:.15rem}
.cap strong{font:400 clamp(1.1rem,3vw,1.9rem)/1.3 var(--serif)}
.cap span{font-size:clamp(.85rem,1.8vw,1rem);opacity:.9}
.sl-btn{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:3;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(10,36,27,.65);color:#fff;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 0 3px}
.sl-btn:hover{background:rgba(10,36,27,.9)}
.sl-prev{left:.6rem}.sl-next{right:.6rem}
.dots{position:absolute;right:.8rem;bottom:.8rem;z-index:3;display:flex;gap:.45rem}
.dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;background:transparent;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.dot[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
@media (max-width:640px){.slider{aspect-ratio:16/10}.sl-btn{width:34px;height:34px}}

/* ---------- notices / sidebar ---------- */
.nlist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nitem{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:.7rem;padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
.nitem:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.datebox{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:2px;line-height:1.2;padding:.3rem 0;align-self:start}
.datebox b{display:block;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}
.datebox small{font-size:.78rem}
.ntitle{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}
.ntitle:hover{color:var(--link);text-decoration:underline}
.tag-new{display:inline-block;background:var(--alert);color:#fff;font-size:.72rem;padding:0 .4rem;border-radius:2px;margin-left:.35rem;vertical-align:middle}
.more{margin:.7rem 0 0}
.pw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:.8rem;align-items:start;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.avatar{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:400 1.7rem/1 var(--serif);overflow:hidden;flex:none}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.pw strong{display:block;line-height:1.4}
.pw span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.quote{margin:0 0 .5rem;font-size:.96rem}

.cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.cal-head b{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.1rem}
.cal-head button{width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1}
.cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px;text-align:center}
.cal-grid .wd{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);padding:.2rem 0}
.cal-grid .wd.off,.cal-grid .d.off{color:var(--alert)}
.cal-grid .d{position:relative;padding:.35rem 0;font-size:.92rem;border-radius:2px;line-height:1.3}
.cal-grid .d.today{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.cal-grid .d.ev::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2px;width:5px;height:5px;margin-left:-2.5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.cal-ev{list-style:none;margin:.7rem 0 0;padding:.6rem 0 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.92rem}
.cal-ev li{display:flex;gap:.5rem;padding:.15rem 0}
.cal-ev b{flex:none;min-width:1.6rem;color:var(--alert)}

.mapsvg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:.7rem}
.mapsvg .g{fill:var(--soft)}.mapsvg .b{fill:var(--line)}.mapsvg .r{stroke:var(--panel);fill:none;stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round}.mapsvg .r2{stroke:var(--line);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:5 5}
.mapsvg .pin{fill:var(--alert)}.mapsvg .pin-dot{fill:#fff}
.addr{margin:0 0 .7rem;font-size:.95rem}

/* ---------- content blocks ---------- */
.facts{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:.6rem}
.facts th,.facts td{text-align:left;padding:.5rem .7rem;border:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
.facts th{background:var(--soft);font-weight:600;width:38%}
.checks{margin:.2rem 0 1rem;padding-left:0;list-style:none}
.checks li{padding:.3rem 0 .3rem 1.6rem;position:relative}
.checks li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.15rem;top:.85rem;width:.55rem;height:.55rem;background:var(--accent);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.deadline{background:var(--soft);border-left:5px solid var(--alert);padding:.6rem .9rem;margin:0 0 1rem}
.pmsg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:1.2rem;align-items:start}
.pmsg .avatar{width:150px;height:150px;font-size:3.6rem;border-radius:3px}
.pmsg h2{margin:0;font:400 1.35rem/1.4 var(--serif)}
.pmsg .muted{display:block;margin-bottom:.8rem}
@media (max-width:560px){.pmsg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pmsg .avatar{width:120px;height:120px}}
.search{margin-bottom:1rem}
.search input,.fld input,.fld textarea,.login input{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:.55rem .7rem}
.people{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:.8rem}
.person{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;padding:.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;background:var(--panel)}
.person b{display:block;line-height:1.4}
.person span,.person a{display:block;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.person a{color:var(--link);text-decoration:none}
.rlist{display:grid;gap:.8rem}
.res{border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--brand);padding:.75rem 1rem;background:var(--panel)}
.res h3{margin:0 0 .2rem;font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.5}
.res .meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.res .rate{display:inline-block;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:0 .5rem;border-radius:2px;margin-right:.5rem;color:var(--ink)}
.res p{margin:.4rem 0 0}
.res .btn{margin-top:.6rem}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:.6rem}
.tile{position:relative;display:block;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:var(--brand);aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;text-align:left;width:100%}
.tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.tile.ph{cursor:default}
.tile .tc{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:.3rem .55rem;background:rgba(10,36,27,.82);font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.4}
.tile:hover img{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.vlist{display:grid;gap:.8rem}
.vid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:132px 1fr;gap:1rem;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:.6rem;background:var(--panel)}
.vthumb{aspect-ratio:16/10;background:var(--brand-deep);display:grid;place-items:center}
.vthumb i{width:0;height:0;border-left:20px solid #fff;border-top:12px solid transparent;border-bottom:12px solid transparent;margin-left:6px}
.vid h3{margin:0;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.5}
.vid p{margin:.15rem 0 .4rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem}
@media (max-width:520px){.vid{grid-template-columns:96px 1fr}}
.cinfo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:.35rem 1rem;margin:0 0 1rem}
.cinfo dt{font-weight:600}.cinfo dd{margin:0}
.nfull .when{color:var(--muted);margin:-.4rem 0 1rem}

.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:1rem}
.lb figure{margin:0;max-width:min(1100px,88vw);text-align:center;color:#fff}
.lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:78vh;display:block;margin:0 auto}
.lb figcaption{margin-top:.6rem}
.lb figcaption span{opacity:.6;margin-left:.6rem}
.lb button{position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;border:0;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}
.lb-x{top:1rem;right:1rem}.lb-p{left:.6rem;top:50%}.lb-n{right:.6rem;top:50%}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
.foot{background:var(--brand-deep);color:var(--on-brand);margin-top:1.5rem}
.foot a{color:#CFE9DB}
.foot-in{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.6rem 1rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:2rem}
.foot h2{font:400 1.25rem/1.4 var(--serif);margin:0 0 .6rem;padding-bottom:.4rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.foot p{margin:.2rem 0;font-size:.95rem}
.foot ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;columns:2;column-gap:1.5rem}
.foot li{padding:.2rem 0;break-inside:avoid}
.foot-bar{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:.8rem 1rem calc(.8rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;font-size:.9rem}
@media (max-width:700px){.foot-in{grid-template-columns:1fr}.foot ul{columns:1}}

/* ---------- admin ---------- */
.login{max-width:400px;margin:2rem auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;padding:1.4rem}
.login h1{font:400 1.5rem/1.4 var(--serif);margin:0 0 1rem}
.login label,.fld label,.fld .lbl{display:block;font-weight:500;margin:.7rem 0 .25rem}
.login .btn{width:100%;margin-top:1rem;padding:.6rem}
.err{color:var(--alert)}.ok{color:var(--ok)}
.admin{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:.8rem}
.admin-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--brand-deep);color:#fff;padding:.7rem 1rem;border-radius:3px;position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20}
.admin-top strong{font:400 1.2rem var(--serif)}
.admin-top .btn.ghost{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.admin-top .btn:not(.ghost){background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:600}
.admin-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem}
.admin-status{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem 1.2rem;margin:.6rem 0;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted)}
.admin-status .dirty{color:var(--alert);font-weight:600}
.notice-bar{background:var(--soft);border-left:5px solid var(--alert);padding:.6rem .9rem;margin:.6rem 0}
.admin-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px minmax(0,1fr);gap:1rem;align-items:start}
.tabs{display:grid;gap:2px;position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 64px)}
.tab{font:inherit;text-align:left;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:.5rem .8rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px}
.tab.on{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border-color:var(--brand)}
.admin-main{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:1rem;min-width:0}
.admin-main h2{font:400 1.4rem/1.4 var(--serif);margin:0 0 .8rem;padding-bottom:.4rem;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent)}
.blk{margin-bottom:1.6rem}
.blk-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.blk-head h3{margin:0;font-size:1.05rem}
.fld{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.fld small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.15rem}
.item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:.5rem;background:var(--panel)}
.item-head{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;padding:.4rem .6rem;background:var(--soft)}
.item-head img,.item-head .th{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:2px;flex:none;background:var(--line)}
.item-title{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;font:inherit;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;padding:.25rem 0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tools{display:flex;gap:.3rem;flex:none}
.tools button{font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;min-width:34px;padding:.15rem .5rem;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}
.tools button.del{color:var(--alert);border-color:var(--alert)}
.tools button.del.sure{background:var(--alert);color:#fff}
.item-body{padding:.7rem .8rem .5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.imgf{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;align-items:center}
.imgprev{width:96px;height:64px;background:var(--soft);border:1px dashed var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;overflow:hidden}
.imgprev img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(1.2rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:400;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:.65rem 1.1rem;border-radius:3px;max-width:92vw;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .admin-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tabs{position:static;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:.4rem;padding-bottom:.3rem}
  .tab{white-space:nowrap;flex:none}
}
</style>
</head>

বাতায়ন","url":"https://bangladesh.gov.bd"}],"admin":{"id":"admin","salt":"sch-8f2a91c4","hash":"84501d38ac47042c5a26ffe424d8efa7944cdd3f3e8771f186777d7963502ebb","isDefault":true}}</script>
<script id="app-js">(function () {
'use strict';
var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || document).querySelector(s); };
var $$ = function (s, r) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
var BND = '০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯';
var bn = function (v) { return String(v).replace(/\d/g, function (d) { return BND[+d]; }); };
var ascii = function (v) { return String(v).replace(/[০-৯]/g, function (d) { return BND.indexOf(d); }); };
var MON = ['জানুয়ারি','ফেব্রুয়ারি','মার্চ','এপ্রিল','মে','জুন','জুলাই','আগস্ট','সেপ্টেম্বর','অক্টোবর','নভেম্বর','ডিসেম্বর'];
var MONS = ['জানু','ফেব্রু','মার্চ','এপ্রিল','মে','জুন','জুলাই','আগস্ট','সেপ্টে','অক্টো','নভে','ডিসে'];
var WD = ['র','সো','ম','বু','বৃ','শু','শ'];
var WDF = ['রবিবার','সোমবার','মঙ্গলবার','বুধবার','বৃহস্পতিবার','শুক্রবার','শনিবার'];
var ESC = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' };
var esc = function (s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return ESC[c]; }); };
var paras = function (t) { return String(t || '').split(/\n+/).map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean).map(function (s) { return '<p>' + esc(s) + '</p>'; }).join(''); };
var uid = function () { return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9); };
var pad = function (n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
var todayISO = function () { var t = new Date(); return t.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(t.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(t.getDate()); };
var imgSrc = function (v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.indexOf('data:image/') === 0 ? v : ''; };
function safeUrl(u) {
  u = String(u || '').trim();
  if (!u) return '';
  if (/^(https?:|mailto:|tel:)/i.test(u)) return u;
  if (/^[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+([\/?#]|$)/.test(u)) return 'https://' + u;
  return '';
}
function initial(s) {
  s = String(s || '').trim();
  if (!s) return '?';
  try { if (window.Intl && Intl.Segmenter) { var it = new Intl.Segmenter('bn', { granularity: 'grapheme' }).segment(s)[Symbol.iterator]().next(); return it.value.segment; } } catch (e) {}
  return s.charAt(0);
}
function fmtDate(iso) {
  var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!m) return '';
  return bn(+m[3]) + ' ' + MON[+m[2] - 1] + ' ' + bn(m[1]);
}
function ssGet(k) { try { return sessionStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
function ssSet(k, v) { try { sessionStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
function ssDel(k) { try { sessionStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) {} }

/* ---------- data ---------- */
var D;
try { D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('site-data').textContent); } catch (e) { D = {}; }
var LISTS = ['notices','slides','teachers','staff','results','gallery','videos','pages','events','footerLinks'];
function normalize() {
  LISTS.forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(D[k])) D[k] = []; });
  D.about = D.about || {}; if (!Array.isArray(D.about.facts)) D.about.facts = [];
  D.admission = D.admission || {}; if (!Array.isArray(D.admission.points)) D.admission.points = [];
  D.principal = D.principal || {}; D.contact = D.contact || {};
  D.admin = D.admin || { id: 'admin', salt: 's', hash: '', isDefault: true };
  [D.notices, D.slides, D.teachers, D.staff, D.results, D.gallery, D.videos, D.pages, D.events, D.footerLinks, D.about.facts, D.admission.points].forEach(function (a) {
    a.forEach(function (it) { if (!it.id) it.id = uid(); });
  });
}
function getPath(p) { return p ? p.split('.').reduce(function (o, k) { return o && o[k]; }, D) : D; }
function setField(p, i, f, val) { var t = getPath(p); var o = i === '' ? t : t[+i]; if (o) o[f] = val; }
var sortedNotices = function () { return D.notices.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return String(b.date || '').localeCompare(String(a.date || '')); }); };
var isNew = function (n) { var t = new Date(n.date).getTime(); return t && (Date.now() - t) < 8 * 864e5 && (Date.now() - t) > -864e5; };

/* ---------- state ---------- */
var S = { route: 'home', arg: '', calY: 0, calM: 0, admin: false, tab: 'general', open: null, del: null, dirty: false, saving: false, menuOpen: false, subOpen: false };
var ART = null, ARTP = null, sliderTimer = null, sliderIdx = 0, lb = null, fails = 0, lockUntil = 0, delTimer = null;

function parseHash() {
  var h = (location.hash || '').replace(/^#\/?/, '');
  var parts = h.split('/');
  S.route = parts[0] || 'home';
  S.arg = parts.slice(1).join('/');
}
function navigate(path) {
  try { history.pushState(null, '', '#/' + path); } catch (e) {}
  var parts = path.split('/');
  S.route = parts[0] || 'home'; S.arg = parts.slice(1).join('/');
  S.menuOpen = false; S.subOpen = false;
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

/* ---------- site: header, ticker, menu ---------- */
function header() {
  var logo = imgSrc(D.logo) ? '<img src="' + imgSrc(D.logo) + '" alt="">' : esc(initial(D.name));
  return '<a class="skip" href="#main">মূল বিষয়বস্তুতে যান</a><header class="masthead"><div class="masthead-inner"><a class="logo" href="#/" aria-label="হোম পেজ">' + logo + '</a><div><div class="school-name"><a href="#/">' + esc(D.name) + '</a></div>' + (D.tagline ? '<p class="tagline">' + esc(D.tagline) + '</p>' : '') + '</div></div></header><div class="paar" aria-hidden="true"></div>';
}
function ticker() {
  var ns = sortedNotices().slice(0, 10);
  if (!ns.length) return '';
  var set = ns.map(function (n) { return '<a class="ticker-item" href="#/notice/' + esc(n.id) + '">' + esc(n.title) + '</a>'; }).join('');
  var chars = ns.reduce(function (a, n) { return a + String(n.title || '').length + 8; }, 0);
  var dur = Math.max(28, Math.round(chars * 0.22));
  return '<div class="ticker" role="region" aria-label="সর্বশেষ নোটিশ"><span class="ticker-label">সর্বশেষ নোটিশ</span><div class="ticker-view"><div class="ticker-move" style="--dur:' + dur + 's"><div class="ticker-set">' + set + '</div><div class="ticker-set" aria-hidden="true">' + set.replace(/<a /g, '<a tabindex="-1" ') + '</div></div></div></div>';
}
function menu() {
  var A = function (r, l) { var on = S.route === r; return '<li><a href="#/' + r + '"' + (on ? ' class="on" aria-current="page"' : '') + '>' + l + '</a></li>'; };
  var apply = safeUrl(D.admission.applyUrl);
  var applyItem = apply ? '<li><a class="apply" href="' + esc(apply) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ভর্তির আবেদন</a></li>' : '<li><a class="apply" href="#/admission">ভর্তির আবেদন</a></li>';
  var sub = D.pages.map(function (p) { return '<li><a href="#/page/' + esc(p.id) + '">' + esc(p.title) + '</a></li>'; }).join('') + '<li><a href="#/contact">যোগাযোগ</a></li>';
  var othersOn = S.route === 'page' || S.route === 'contact';
  return '<nav class="menu' + (S.menuOpen ? ' open' : '') + '" aria-label="প্রধান মেনু"><div class="menu-inner"><button class="menu-toggle" data-act="menu" aria-expanded="' + S.menuOpen + '"><span class="burger" aria-hidden="true"></span>মেনু</button><ul>' +
    A('home', 'হোম') + A('about', 'শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠানের তথ্য') + A('principal', 'অধ্যক্ষের বাণী') + A('teachers', 'শিক্ষকের তথ্য') + A('staff', 'কর্মচারীর তথ্য') + A('admission', 'ভর্তি তথ্য') + applyItem + A('results', 'ফলাফলের তথ্য') + A('gallery', 'গ্যালারী') + A('videos', 'ভিডিও') +
    '<li class="has-sub' + (othersOn ? ' on' : '') + (S.subOpen ? ' open' : '') + '"><button class="mi" data-act="sub" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="' + S.subOpen + '">অন্যান্য</button><ul class="sub">' + sub + '</ul></li></ul></div></nav>';
}

/* ---------- site: sidebar widgets ---------- */
function avatar(p, cls) {
  var src = imgSrc(p.photo);
  return '<div class="avatar' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '') + '">' + (src ? '<img src="' + src + '" alt="">' : esc(initial(p.name))) + '</div>';
}
function wPrincipal() {
  var p = D.principal, msg = String(p.message || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  var short = msg.length > 170 ? msg.slice(0, 170).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…' : msg;
  return '<section class="widget"><h2>অধ্যক্ষের বাণী</h2><div class="wb"><div class="pw">' + avatar(p) + '<div><strong>' + esc(p.name) + '</strong><span>' + esc(p.designation) + '</span></div></div><p class="quote">' + esc(short) + '</p><a class="btn ghost small" href="#/principal">পুরো বাণী পড়ুন</a></div></section>';
}
function wNotices() {
  var ns = sortedNotices().slice(0, 6);
  var body = ns.length ? '<ul class="nlist">' + ns.map(function (n) {
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(n.date || '');
    var box = m ? '<div class="datebox"><b>' + bn(+m[3]) + '</b><small>' + MONS[+m[2] - 1] + '</small></div>' : '<div class="datebox"><b>•</b></div>';
    return '<li class="nitem">' + box + '<div><a class="ntitle" href="#/notice/' + esc(n.id) + '">' + esc(n.title) + '</a>' + (isNew(n) ? '<span class="tag-new">নতুন</span>' : '') + '</div></li>';
  }).join('') + '</ul><p class="more"><a href="#/notices">সব নোটিশ দেখুন</a></p>' : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো নোটিশ নেই।</p>';
  return '<section class="widget"><h2>নোটিশ বোর্ড</h2><div class="wb">' + body + '</div></section>';
}
function calBody() {
  var y = S.calY, m = S.calM;
  var first = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay(), days = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
  var t = new Date(), isNow = t.getFullYear() === y && t.getMonth() === m;
  var prefix = y + '-' + pad(m + 1);
  var evs = D.events.filter(function (e) { return e.date && e.date.slice(0, 7) === prefix; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.date.localeCompare(b.date); });
  var evd = {}; evs.forEach(function (e) { evd[+e.date.slice(8, 10)] = 1; });
  var h = WD.map(function (w, i) { return '<div class="wd' + (i === 5 || i === 6 ? ' off' : '') + '" title="' + WDF[i] + '">' + w + '</div>'; }).join('');
  for (var i = 0; i < first; i++) h += '<div></div>';
  for (var d = 1; d <= days; d++) {
    var wd = (first + d - 1) % 7;
    h += '<div class="d' + (isNow && t.getDate() === d ? ' today' : '') + (evd[d] ? ' ev' : '') + (wd === 5 || wd === 6 ? ' off' : '') + '">' + bn(d) + '</div>';
  }
  var list = evs.length ? '<ul class="cal-ev">' + evs.map(function (e) { return '<li><b>' + bn(+e.date.slice(8, 10)) + '</b><span>' + esc(e.title) + '</span></li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>' : '';
  return '<div class="cal-head"><button data-act="cal-prev" aria-label="আগের মাস">‹</button><b>' + MON[m] + ' ' + bn(y) + '</b><button data-act="cal-next" aria-label="পরের মাস">›</button></div><div class="cal-grid">' + h + '</div>' + list;
}
function wCalendar() { return '<section class="widget"><h2>ক্যালেন্ডার</h2><div class="wb" id="cal">' + calBody() + '</div></section>'; }
function mapUrl() { return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + encodeURIComponent(D.contact.mapQuery || D.contact.address || ''); }
function wMap() {
  var svg = '<svg class="mapsvg" viewBox="0 0 260 130" role="img" aria-label="ম্যাপের চিত্র"><rect class="g" width="260" height="130"/><rect class="b" x="14" y="12" width="70" height="38" rx="3"/><rect class="b" x="98" y="12" width="60" height="38" rx="3"/><rect class="b" x="176" y="14" width="70" height="30" rx="3"/><rect class="b" x="14" y="82" width="52" height="36" rx="3"/><rect class="b" x="176" y="84" width="70" height="34" rx="3"/><path class="r" d="M0 65 H260"/><path class="r" d="M90 0 V130"/><path class="r" d="M0 118 L260 20"/><path class="r2" d="M0 65 H260"/><path class="r2" d="M90 0 V130"/><path class="pin" d="M130 58c-11 0-18 8-18 17 0 13 18 30 18 30s18-17 18-30c0-9-7-17-18-17z"/><circle class="pin-dot" cx="130" cy="74" r="6"/></svg>';
  return '<section class="widget"><h2>ম্যাপ</h2><div class="wb">' + svg + '<p class="addr">' + esc(D.contact.address) + '</p><a class="btn" href="' + esc(mapUrl()) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">গুগল ম্যাপে দেখুন</a></div></section>';
}

/* ---------- site: pages ---------- */
function slider() {
  if (!D.slides.length) return '';
  var slides = D.slides.map(function (x, i) {
    var img = imgSrc(x.image);
    var cap = (x.title || x.sub) ? '<figcaption class="cap">' + (x.title ? '<strong>' + esc(x.title) + '</strong>' : '') + (x.sub ? '<span>' + esc(x.sub) + '</span>' : '') + '</figcaption>' : '';
    return '<figure class="slide' + (i === 0 ? ' on' : '') + (img ? '' : ' ph v' + (i % 3)) + '">' + (img ? '<img src="' + img + '" alt="' + esc(x.title) + '">' : '') + cap + '</figure>';
  }).join('');
  var nav = D.slides.length > 1 ? '<button class="sl-btn sl-prev" data-act="slide-prev" aria-label="আগের স্লাইড">‹</button><button class="sl-btn sl-next" data-act="slide-next" aria-label="পরের স্লাইড">›</button><div class="dots">' + D.slides.map(function (_, i) { return '<button class="dot" data-act="slide-go" data-i="' + i + '" aria-label="স্লাইড ' + bn(i + 1) + '" aria-current="' + (i === 0) + '"></button>'; }).join('') + '</div>' : '';
  return '<div class="slider" id="slider" role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="ব্যানার">' + slides + nav + '</div>';
}
function startSlider() {
  var el = $('#slider'); if (!el) return;
  var sl = $$('.slide', el), dots = $$('.dot', el);
  if (sl.length < 2) return;
  sliderIdx = 0;
  el._show = function (i) {
    sliderIdx = (i + sl.length) % sl.length;
    sl.forEach(function (s, k) { s.classList.toggle('on', k === sliderIdx); });
    dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.setAttribute('aria-current', String(k === sliderIdx)); });
  };
  var paused = false;
  if (!(window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)) {
    sliderTimer = setInterval(function () { if (!paused && !document.hidden) el._show(sliderIdx + 1); }, 5500);
  }
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { paused = true; });
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { paused = false; });
  el.addEventListener('focusin', function () { paused = true; });
  el.addEventListener('focusout', function () { paused = false; });
  var x0 = null;
  el.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { x0 = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
  el.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
    if (x0 === null) return;
    var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - x0; x0 = null;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) el._show(sliderIdx + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
  });
}
function resultsList(rs) {
  return '<div class="rlist">' + rs.map(function (r) {
    var link = safeUrl(r.link);
    return '<article class="res"><h3>' + esc(r.title) + '</h3><div class="meta">' + (r.passRate ? '<span class="rate">পাসের হার: ' + esc(r.passRate) + '</span>' : '') + (r.year ? esc(r.year) : '') + '</div>' + (r.note ? '<p>' + esc(r.note) + '</p>' : '') + (link ? '<a class="btn small" href="' + esc(link) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ফলাফল দেখুন</a>' : '') + '</article>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}
function galImgs() { return D.gallery.filter(function (g) { return imgSrc(g.image); }); }
function tiles(list) {
  var imgs = galImgs();
  return '<div class="gallery">' + list.map(function (g) {
    var s = imgSrc(g.image), cap = g.caption ? '<span class="tc">' + esc(g.caption) + '</span>' : '';
    if (s) return '<button class="tile" data-act="lb" data-i="' + imgs.indexOf(g) + '"><img src="' + s + '" alt="' + esc(g.caption) + '" loading="lazy">' + cap + '</button>';
    return '<div class="tile ph">' + cap + '</div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}
function home() {
  var p = [slider()];
  var intro = String(D.about.intro || '').split(/\n+/).slice(0, 2).join('\n');
  p.push('<section class="page"><h1>স্বাগতম</h1>' + paras(intro) + '<p><a class="btn" href="#/about">প্রতিষ্ঠান সম্পর্কে আরও জানুন</a></p></section>');
  if (D.results.length) p.push('<section class="page"><h1>সাম্প্রতিক ফলাফল</h1>' + resultsList(D.results.slice(0, 3)) + '<p style="margin-top:.9rem"><a class="btn ghost" href="#/results">সব ফলাফল দেখুন</a></p></section>');
  var gs = galImgs().slice(0, 4);
  if (gs.length) p.push('<section class="page"><h1>গ্যালারী</h1>' + tiles(gs) + '<p style="margin-top:.9rem"><a class="btn ghost" href="#/gallery">সব ছবি দেখুন</a></p></section>');
  return '<div class="stack">' + p.join('') + '</div>';
}
function about() {
  var f = D.about.facts.length ? '<table class="facts"><tbody>' + D.about.facts.map(function (x) { return '<tr><th scope="row">' + esc(x.k) + '</th><td>' + esc(x.v) + '</td></tr>'; }).join('') + '</tbody></table>' : '';
  return '<article class="page"><h1>শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠানের তথ্য</h1>' + paras(D.about.intro) + f + '</article>';
}
function principal() {
  var p = D.principal;
  return '<article class="page"><h1>অধ্যক্ষের বাণী</h1><div class="pmsg">' + avatar(p) + '<div><h2>' + esc(p.name) + '</h2><span class="muted">' + esc(p.designation) + '</span>' + paras(p.message) + '</div></div></article>';
}
function people(list, title, showSubject) {
  var body = list.length ? '<div class="search"><input type="search" id="pq" placeholder="নাম বা বিষয় দিয়ে খুঁজুন" aria-label="খুঁজুন"></div><div class="people">' + list.map(function (t) {
    var ph = String(t.phone || '').trim();
    return '<div class="person" data-t="' + esc((t.name + ' ' + t.designation + ' ' + (t.subject || '')).toLowerCase()) + '">' + avatar(t) + '<div><b>' + esc(t.name) + '</b><span>' + esc(t.designation) + (showSubject && t.subject ? ' — ' + esc(t.subject) : '') + '</span>' + (ph ? '<a href="tel:' + esc(ascii(ph).replace(/[^\d+]/g, '')) + '">' + esc(ph) + '</a>' : '') + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>' : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো তথ্য যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>';
  return '<article class="page"><h1>' + title + '</h1>' + body + '</article>';
}
function admission() {
  var a = D.admission, url = safeUrl(a.applyUrl);
  return '<article class="page"><h1>ভর্তি তথ্য</h1>' + paras(a.intro) + (a.points.length ? '<ul class="checks">' + a.points.map(function (x) { return '<li>' + esc(x.text) + '</li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>' : '') + (a.deadline ? '<p class="deadline"><strong>আবেদনের শেষ তারিখ:</strong> ' + esc(a.deadline) + '</p>' : '') + (url ? '<p><a class="btn big" href="' + esc(url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(a.applyLabel || 'অনলাইনে আবেদন করুন') + '</a></p>' : '') + '</article>';
}
function results() { return '<article class="page"><h1>ফলাফলের তথ্য</h1>' + (D.results.length ? resultsList(D.results) : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো ফলাফল যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>') + '</article>'; }
function gallery() { return '<article class="page"><h1>গ্যালারী</h1>' + (D.gallery.length ? tiles(D.gallery) : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো ছবি যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>') + '</article>'; }
function videos() {
  var b = D.videos.length ? '<div class="vlist">' + D.videos.map(function (v) {
    var u = safeUrl(v.url);
    return '<div class="vid"><div class="vthumb"><i></i></div><div><h3>' + esc(v.title) + '</h3>' + (v.note ? '<p>' + esc(v.note) + '</p>' : '') + (u ? '<a class="btn small" href="' + esc(u) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ভিডিও দেখুন</a>' : '') + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>' : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো ভিডিও যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>';
  return '<article class="page"><h1>ভিডিও</h1>' + b + '</article>';
}
function noticesPage() {
  var ns = sortedNotices();
  return '<article class="page"><h1>সকল নোটিশ</h1>' + (ns.length ? '<ul class="nlist">' + ns.map(function (n) {
    return '<li class="nitem"><div class="datebox"><b>' + bn(+String(n.date || '').slice(8, 10) || 0) + '</b><small>' + (MONS[+String(n.date || '').slice(5, 7) - 1] || '') + '</small></div><div><a class="ntitle" href="#/notice/' + esc(n.id) + '">' + esc(n.title) + '</a>' + (isNew(n) ? '<span class="tag-new">নতুন</span>' : '') + '</div></li>';
  }).join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="empty">এখনো কোনো নোটিশ নেই।</p>') + '</article>';
}
function noticeOne() {
  var n = D.notices.filter(function (x) { return x.id === S.arg; })[0];
  if (!n) return notFound();
  var l = safeUrl(n.link);
  return '<article class="page nfull"><a class="back" href="#/notices">সব নোটিশ</a><h1>' + esc(n.title) + '</h1><p class="when">প্রকাশের তারিখ: ' + esc(fmtDate(n.date)) + '</p>' + paras(n.body) + (l ? '<p><a class="btn" href="' + esc(l) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">সংযুক্তি দেখুন</a></p>' : '') + '</article>';
}
function customPage() {
  var p = D.pages.filter(function (x) { return x.id === S.arg; })[0];
  if (!p) return notFound();
  return '<article class="page"><h1>' + esc(p.title) + '</h1>' + paras(p.body) + '</article>';
}
function contactPage() {
  var c = D.contact, ph = String(c.phone || '').trim();
  return '<article class="page"><h1>যোগাযোগ</h1><dl class="cinfo"><dt>ঠিকানা</dt><dd>' + esc(c.address) + '</dd>' + (ph ? '<dt>ফোন</dt><dd><a href="tel:' + esc(ascii(ph).replace(/[^\d+]/g, '')) + '">' + esc(ph) + '</a></dd>' : '') + (c.email ? '<dt>ইমেইল</dt><dd><a href="mailto:' + esc(c.email) + '">' + esc(c.email) + '</a></dd>' : '') + '</dl><a class="btn" href="' + esc(mapUrl()) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">গুগল ম্যাপে দেখুন</a></article>';
}
function notFound() { return '<article class="page"><h1>পাতাটি পাওয়া যায়নি</h1><p>আপনি যে পাতাটি খুঁজছেন তা নেই বা সরিয়ে ফেলা হয়েছে।</p><p><a class="btn" href="#/">হোম পেজে ফিরে যান</a></p></article>'; }
function page() {
  switch (S.route) {
    case 'home': return home();
    case 'about': return about();
    case 'principal': return principal();
    case 'teachers': return people(D.teachers, 'শিক্ষকের তথ্য', true);
    case 'staff': return people(D.staff, 'কর্মচারীর তথ্য', false);
    case 'admission': return admission();
    case 'results': return results();
    case 'gallery': return gallery();
    case 'videos': return videos();
    case 'notices': return noticesPage();
    case 'notice': return noticeOne();
    case 'page': return customPage();
    case 'contact': return contactPage();
    default: return notFound();
  }
}
function footer() {
  var links = D.footerLinks.filter(function (l) { return safeUrl(l.url); }).map(function (l) { return '<li><a href="' + esc(safeUrl(l.url)) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(l.label) + '</a></li>'; }).join('');
  var c = D.contact;
  return '<footer class="foot"><div class="foot-in"><div><h2>' + esc(D.name) + '</h2>' + (c.address ? '<p>' + esc(c.address) + '</p>' : '') + (c.phone ? '<p>ফোন: ' + esc(c.phone) + '</p>' : '') + (c.email ? '<p>ইমেইল: ' + esc(c.email) + '</p>' : '') + '</div><div><h2>গুরুত্বপূর্ণ লিংক</h2>' + (links ? '<ul>' + links + '</ul>' : '<p>কোনো লিংক যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>') + '</div></div><div class="foot-bar"><span>' + esc(D.footerNote) + '</span><a href="#/admin">অ্যাডমিন লগইন</a></div></footer>';
}
function siteView() {
  return header() + ticker() + menu() + '<div class="wrap"><div class="layout"><main class="col-main" id="main" tabindex="-1">' + page() + '</main><aside class="col-left" aria-label="বাম সাইডবার">' + wPrincipal() + wCalendar() + '</aside><aside class="col-right" aria-label="ডান সাইডবার">' + wNotices() + wMap() + '</aside></div></div>' + footer();
}

  { key: 'videos', label: 'ভিডিও', blocks: [{ type: 'list', path: 'videos', title: 'ভিডিও তালিকা', titleKey: 'title', fields: [F('title', 'শিরোনাম'), F('url', 'ভিডিওর লিংক', 'url', { hint: 'ইউটিউব বা ফেসবুক ভিডিওর লিংক' }), F('note', 'ছোট বিবরণ')] }] },

  { key: 'security', label: 'লগইন তথ্য', special: 'security' }
];
var NEWITEM = {
  notices: function () { return { title: 'নতুন নোটিশ', date: todayISO(), body: '', link: '' }; },
  slides: function () { return { image: '', title: 'নতুন স্লাইড', sub: '' }; },
  'about.facts': function () { return { k: 'বিষয়', v: '' }; },
  teachers: function () { return { name: 'নতুন শিক্ষক', designation: '', subject: '', phone: '', photo: '' }; },
  staff: function () { return { name: 'নতুন কর্মচারী', designation: '', phone: '', photo: '' }; },
  'admission.points': function () { return { text: 'নতুন পয়েন্ট' }; },
  results: function () { return { title: 'নতুন ফলাফল', year: '', passRate: '', note: '', link: '' }; },
  gallery: function () { return { image: '', caption: '' }; },
  videos: function () { return { title: 'নতুন ভিডিও', url: '', note: '' }; },
  pages: function () { return { title: 'নতুন পাতা', body: '' }; },
  events: function () { return { date: todayISO(), title: 'নতুন ইভেন্ট' }; },
  footerLinks: function () { return { label: 'নতুন লিংক', url: '' }; }
};
var TOP = { notices: 1, results: 1 };

/* ---------- admin: views ---------- */
function fieldHTML(f, obj, p, i) {
  var v = obj[f.k] == null ? '' : obj[f.k];
  var at = 'data-p="' + esc(p) + '" data-i="' + i + '" data-f="' + f.k + '"';
  var id = 'f_' + p.replace(/\W/g, '_') + '_' + i + '_' + f.k;
  var ctl;
  if (f.t === 'image') {
    var s = imgSrc(v);
    ctl = '<div class="imgf"><div class="imgprev">' + (s ? '<img src="' + s + '" alt="">' : 'ছবি নেই') + '</div><label class="btn ghost small">ছবি বাছাই করুন<input type="file" accept="image/*" hidden data-img="1" data-w="' + (f.w || 1000) + '" data-fmt="' + (f.fmt || 'image/jpeg') + '" ' + at + '></label>' + (s ? '<button class="btn ghost small" data-act="clearimg" ' + at + '>ছবি সরান</button>' : '') + '</div>';
    return '<div class="fld"><span class="lbl">' + f.l + '</span>' + ctl + (f.hint ? '<small>' + f.hint + '</small>' : '') + '</div>';
  }
  if (f.t === 'textarea') ctl = '<textarea id="' + id + '" rows="' + (f.rows || 5) + '" ' + at + '>' + esc(v) + '</textarea>';
  else ctl = '<input id="' + id + '" type="' + (f.t === 'date' ? 'date' : f.t === 'url' ? 'url' : 'text') + '" value="' + esc(v) + '" ' + at + '>';
  return '<div class="fld"><label for="' + id + '">' + f.l + '</label>' + ctl + (f.hint ? '<small>' + f.hint + '</small>' : '') + '</div>';
}
function blockView(b) {
  if (b.type === 'single') {
    var o = getPath(b.path) || {};
    return '<div class="blk">' + b.fields.map(function (f) { return fieldHTML(f, o, b.path, ''); }).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  var arr = getPath(b.path) || [];
  var items = arr.map(function (it, i) {
    var key = b.path + ':' + it.id, open = S.open === key;
    var th = b.thumb ? (imgSrc(it[b.thumb]) ? '<img src="' + imgSrc(it[b.thumb]) + '" alt="">' : '<span class="th"></span>') : '';
    var t = String(it[b.titleKey] || '').trim() || '(শিরোনামহীন)';
    return '<div class="item"><div class="item-head">' + th + '<button class="item-title" data-act="toggle" data-key="' + esc(key) + '" aria-expanded="' + open + '">' + esc(t) + '</button><div class="tools"><button data-act="up" data-p="' + b.path + '" data-i="' + i + '" aria-label="ওপরে সরান">↑</button><button data-act="down" data-p="' + b.path + '" data-i="' + i + '" aria-label="নিচে সরান">↓</button><button class="del' + (S.del === key ? ' sure' : '') + '" data-act="del" data-p="' + b.path + '" data-i="' + i + '" data-key="' + esc(key) + '">' + (S.del === key ? 'নিশ্চিত?' : 'মুছুন') + '</button></div></div><div class="item-body"' + (open ? '' : ' hidden') + ' data-tk="' + b.titleKey + '">' + b.fields.map(function (f) { return fieldHTML(f, it, b.path, i); }).join('') + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  var bulk = b.bulk ? '<label class="btn ghost">একসাথে অনেক ছবি যোগ করুন<input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple hidden data-bulk="' + b.path + '"></label>' : '';
  return '<div class="blk"><div class="blk-head"><h3>' + b.title + '</h3><div class="tools"><button class="btn" data-act="add" data-p="' + b.path + '">+ নতুন যোগ করুন</button>' + bulk + '</div></div>' + (items || '<p class="empty">কিছু যোগ করা হয়নি।</p>') + '</div>';
}
function securityView() {
  return '<div class="blk"><div class="fld"><label for="sec-id">ইউজার আইডি</label><input id="sec-id" type="text" autocomplete="username" value="' + esc(D.admin.id) + '"></div><div class="fld"><label for="sec-old">বর্তমান পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input id="sec-old" type="password" autocomplete="current-password"></div><div class="fld"><label for="sec-new">নতুন পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input id="sec-new" type="password" autocomplete="new-password"><small>কমপক্ষে ৬ অক্ষর</small></div><div class="fld"><label for="sec-new2">নতুন পাসওয়ার্ড আবার লিখুন</label><input id="sec-new2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password"></div><p><button class="btn" data-act="setpw">আইডি ও পাসওয়ার্ড পরিবর্তন করুন</button></p><p id="sec-msg" role="status"></p><p class="muted">পরিবর্তনের পর ওপরের "সংরক্ষণ" বাটনে চাপ দিন, নইলে নতুন তথ্য সাইটে থাকবে না।</p></div>';
}
function saveLabel() { return ART === null && ARTP === 'done' ? 'সাইট ফাইল ডাউনলোড করুন' : 'সংরক্ষণ ও প্রকাশ করুন'; }
function statusHTML() {
  var mb = new Blob([JSON.stringify(D)]).size / 1048576;
  return '<span class="dirty" id="dirty"' + (S.dirty ? '' : ' hidden') + '>অসংরক্ষিত পরিবর্তন আছে</span><span>সাইটের আকার: ' + bn(mb.toFixed(1)) + ' MB / ১৬ MB</span>';
}
function adminView() {
  var sec = SECTIONS.filter(function (s) { return s.key === S.tab; })[0] || SECTIONS[0];
  var nav = SECTIONS.map(function (s) { return '<button class="tab' + (s.key === sec.key ? ' on' : '') + '" data-act="tab" data-k="' + s.key + '">' + s.label + '</button>'; }).join('');
  var body = sec.special === 'security' ? securityView() : sec.blocks.map(blockView).join('');
  return '<div class="admin"><div class="admin-top"><div><strong>অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল</strong></div><div class="admin-actions"><a class="btn ghost" href="#/">সাইট দেখুন</a><button class="btn" id="savebtn" data-act="save"' + (S.saving ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + saveLabel() + '</button><button class="btn ghost" data-act="logout">লগআউট</button></div></div><div class="admin-status" id="astatus">' + statusHTML() + '</div>' + (D.admin.isDefault ? '<div class="notice-bar">নিরাপত্তার জন্য ডিফল্ট পাসওয়ার্ড বদলে নিন। "লগইন তথ্য" ট্যাবে যান।</div>' : '') + '<div class="admin-body"><nav class="tabs" aria-label="অ্যাডমিন মেনু">' + nav + '</nav><section class="admin-main"><h2>' + sec.label + '</h2>' + body + '</section></div></div>';
}
function loginView() {
  return '<div class="wrap"><div class="login"><h1>অ্যাডমিন লগইন</h1><label for="lid">ইউজার আইডি</label><input id="lid" type="text" autocomplete="username" data-enter="login"><label for="lpw">পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input id="lpw" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" data-enter="login"><p id="lmsg" class="err" role="alert"></p><button class="btn" data-act="login">লগইন করুন</button><p style="text-align:center;margin:1rem 0 0"><a href="#/">সাইটে ফিরে যান</a></p></div></div>';
}

/* ---------- admin: actions ---------- */
function sha(text, salt) {
  var c = window.crypto;
  if (!c || !c.subtle) return Promise.resolve('');
  return c.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(salt + ':' + text)).then(function (b) {
    return Array.prototype.map.call(new Uint8Array(b), function (x) { return x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); }).join('');
  });
}
function toast(msg, ms) {
  var t = $('#toast'); if (t) t.remove();
  t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'toast'; t.className = 'toast'; t.setAttribute('role', 'status'); t.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(function () { if (t.parentNode) t.remove(); }, ms || 3500);
}
function markDirty() { S.dirty = true; var d = $('#dirty'); if (d) d.hidden = false; }
function doLogin() {
  var msg = $('#lmsg');
  if (Date.now() < lockUntil) { msg.textContent = 'কয়েকবার ভুল হয়েছে। ৩০ সেকেন্ড পর আবার চেষ্টা করুন।'; return; }
  var id = $('#lid').value.trim(), pw = $('#lpw').value;
  if (!window.crypto || !window.crypto.subtle) { msg.textContent = 'এই ব্রাউজারে লগইন চালু করা যাচ্ছে না। https ঠিকানায় খুলুন।'; return; }
  sha(pw, D.admin.salt).then(function (h) {
    if (id === D.admin.id && h === D.admin.hash) { fails = 0; S.admin = true; ssSet('sch_admin', '1'); render(); }
    else { fails++; if (fails >= 5) { lockUntil = Date.now() + 30000; fails = 0; } msg.textContent = 'ইউজার আইডি বা পাসওয়ার্ড সঠিক নয়।'; }
  });
}
function setCreds() {
  var nid = $('#sec-id').value.trim(), old = $('#sec-old').value, n1 = $('#sec-new').value, n2 = $('#sec-new2').value, msg = $('#sec-msg');
  var bad = function (t) { msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'err'; };
  if (!nid) return bad('ইউজার আইডি লিখুন।');
  sha(old, D.admin.salt).then(function (h) {
    if (h !== D.admin.hash) return bad('বর্তমান পাসওয়ার্ড সঠিক নয়।');
    if (n1.length < 6) return bad('নতুন পাসওয়ার্ড কমপক্ষে ৬ অক্ষরের হতে হবে।');
    if (n1 !== n2) return bad('দুটি পাসওয়ার্ড মেলেনি।');
    var salt = uid() + uid();
    return sha(n1, salt).then(function (nh) {
      D.admin = { id: nid, salt: salt, hash: nh, isDefault: false };
      markDirty(); msg.textContent = 'পরিবর্তন হয়েছে। এখন ওপরের "সংরক্ষণ" বাটনে চাপ দিন।'; msg.className = 'ok';
      ['sec-old', 'sec-new', 'sec-new2'].forEach(function (i) { $('#' + i).value = ''; });
      var nb = $('.notice-bar'); if (nb) nb.remove();
    });
  });
}
function shrink(file, maxSide, fmt) {
  return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
    var fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onerror = rej;
    fr.onload = function () {
      var img = new Image();
      img.onerror = rej;
      img.onload = function () {
        var s = Math.min(1, maxSide / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
        var w = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * s)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * s));
        var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
        var x = c.getContext('2d');
        if (fmt !== 'image/png') { x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); }
        x.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
        res(c.toDataURL(fmt || 'image/jpeg', 0.74));
      };
      img.src = fr.result;
    };
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
var HEAD_FONTS = '<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Tiro+Bangla&display=swap">';
var FAVICON = '<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 viewBox=%270 0 100 100%27%3E%3Ctext y=%27.9em%27 font-size=%2790%27%3E%F0%9F%8F%AB%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">';
function buildDoc() {
  var css = document.getElementById('app-css').textContent;
  var js = document.getElementById('app-js').textContent;
  var data = JSON.stringify(D).replace(/</g, '\\u003c').replace(/\u2028/g, '\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g, '\\u2029');
  return '<!doctype html>\n<html lang="bn">\n<head>\n<meta charset="utf-8">\n<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">\n<title>' + esc(D.name) + '</title>\n' + FAVICON + '\n' + HEAD_FONTS + '\n<style id="app-css">' + css + '</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<div id="app"></div>\n<script id="site-data" type="application/json">' + data + '<\/script>\n<script id="app-js">' + js + '<\/script>\n</body>\n</html>\n';
}
function download(html) {
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }));
  a.download = 'index.html';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1000);
}
function setSaving(v) { S.saving = v; var b = $('#savebtn'); if (b) { b.disabled = v; b.textContent = v ? 'সংরক্ষণ হচ্ছে…' : saveLabel(); } }
function save() {
  if (S.saving) return;
  setSaving(true);
  Promise.resolve(ARTP === 'done' || ARTP === null ? null : ARTP).then(function () {
    var html = buildDoc();
    if (html.length > 15.5 * 1048576) { toast('সাইটের আকার অনেক বড় হয়ে গেছে। কিছু ছবি মুছে ছোট করুন।', 6000); setSaving(false); return; }
    if (!ART) { download(html); S.dirty = false; toast('index.html ফাইলটি ডাউনলোড হয়েছে। এটি আপনার হোস্টিংয়ে আপলোড করুন।', 6000); setSaving(false); return; }
    ssSet('sch_toast', '1'); ssSet('sch_return', '1'); ssSet('sch_tab', S.tab);
    ART.publish(html).then(function () {
      S.dirty = false; setSaving(false); var d = $('#dirty'); if (d) d.hidden = true; toast('সংরক্ষিত ও প্রকাশিত হয়েছে ✓');
    }, function (e) {
      ssDel('sch_toast'); ssDel('sch_return'); setSaving(false);
      var c = e && e.code;
      if (c === 'conflict') toast('অন্য কেউ সাইট আপডেট করেছে। পাতাটি নতুন করে লোড হচ্ছে।', 6000);
      else if (c === 'not_writer' || c === 'not_granted' || c === 'consent_required' || c === 'capability_disabled' || c === 'not_declared') toast('এই লিংক থেকে সংরক্ষণের অনুমতি নেই। সাইটের মালিক নিজের অ্যাকাউন্টে খুলে সংরক্ষণ করুন।', 8000);
      else if (c === 'too_large') toast('সাইটের আকার অনেক বড়। কিছু ছবি মুছে ছোট করুন।', 6000);
      else if (c === 'rate_limited') toast('একটু পরে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।', 5000);
      else toast('সংরক্ষণ করা যায়নি। আবার চেষ্টা করুন।', 5000);
    });
  });
}

/* ---------- lightbox ---------- */
function drawLB() {
  var el = $('#lb');
  if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'lb'; el.className = 'lb'; el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog'); el.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'ছবি'); document.body.appendChild(el); }
  var g = lb.imgs[lb.i];
  el.innerHTML = '<button class="lb-x" data-act="lb-close" aria-label="বন্ধ করুন">×</button>' + (lb.imgs.length > 1 ? '<button class="lb-p" data-act="lb-prev" aria-label="আগের ছবি">‹</button><button class="lb-n" data-act="lb-next" aria-label="পরের ছবি">›</button>' : '') + '<figure><img src="' + imgSrc(g.image) + '" alt="' + esc(g.caption) + '"><figcaption>' + esc(g.caption) + '<span>' + bn(lb.i + 1) + '/' + bn(lb.imgs.length) + '</span></figcaption></figure>';
}
function closeLB() { var el = $('#lb'); if (el) el.remove(); lb = null; }

/* ---------- render ---------- */
function render() {
  clearInterval(sliderTimer);
  closeLB();
  var app = $('#app');
  if (S.route === 'admin') {
    document.title = 'অ্যাডমিন — ' + D.name;
    app.innerHTML = S.admin ? adminView() : loginView();
    return;
  }
  document.title = D.name;
  app.innerHTML = siteView();
  startSlider();
}

/* ---------- events ---------- */
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var a = e.target.closest('a[href^="#/"]');
  if (a && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); navigate(a.getAttribute('href').slice(2)); return; }
  if (!e.target.closest('.has-sub') && S.subOpen) { S.subOpen = false; var hs = $('.has-sub'); if (hs) { hs.classList.remove('open'); var mb = $('.mi', hs); if (mb) mb.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); } }
  if (e.target.id === 'lb') { closeLB(); return; }
  var b = e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if (!b) return;
  var act = b.dataset.act, p = b.dataset.p, i = b.dataset.i;
  switch (act) {
    case 'menu': S.menuOpen = !S.menuOpen; $('.menu').classList.toggle('open', S.menuOpen); b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(S.menuOpen)); break;
    case 'sub': S.subOpen = !S.subOpen; b.parentNode.classList.toggle('open', S.subOpen); b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(S.subOpen)); break;
    case 'slide-prev': case 'slide-next': case 'slide-go': {
      var el = $('#slider'); if (!el || !el._show) break;
      el._show(act === 'slide-go' ? +i : sliderIdx + (act === 'slide-next' ? 1 : -1)); break;
    }
    case 'cal-prev': case 'cal-next': {
      S.calM += act === 'cal-next' ? 1 : -1;
      if (S.calM < 0) { S.calM = 11; S.calY--; } if (S.calM > 11) { S.calM = 0; S.calY++; }
      $('#cal').innerHTML = calBody(); break;
    }
    case 'lb': { var imgs = galImgs(); if (!imgs.length) break; lb = { i: +i, imgs: imgs }; drawLB(); break; }
    case 'lb-close': closeLB(); break;
    case 'lb-prev': lb.i = (lb.i - 1 + lb.imgs.length) % lb.imgs.length; drawLB(); break;
    case 'lb-next': lb.i = (lb.i + 1) % lb.imgs.length; drawLB(); break;
    case 'login': doLogin(); break;
    case 'logout': S.admin = false; S.dirty = false; ssDel('sch_admin'); navigate(''); break;
    case 'tab': S.tab = b.dataset.k; S.open = null; S.del = null; ssSet('sch_tab', S.tab); render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); break;
    case 'toggle': {
      var key = b.dataset.key, body = b.closest('.item').querySelector('.item-body');
      $$('.item-body').forEach(function (x) { if (x !== body) x.hidden = true; });
      body.hidden = !body.hidden; S.open = body.hidden ? null : key; b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!body.hidden)); break;
    }
    case 'add': {
      var it = NEWITEM[p](); it.id = uid();
      var arr = getPath(p); if (TOP[p]) arr.unshift(it); else arr.push(it);
      S.open = p + ':' + it.id; markDirty(); render(); break;
    }
    case 'up': case 'down': {
      var ar = getPath(p), k = +i, j = act === 'up' ? k - 1 : k + 1;
      if (j < 0 || j >= ar.length) break;
      var tmp = ar[k]; ar[k] = ar[j]; ar[j] = tmp; markDirty(); render(); break;
    }
    case 'del': {
      var dk = b.dataset.key;
      if (S.del !== dk) { S.del = dk; clearTimeout(delTimer); delTimer = setTimeout(function () { S.del = null; if (S.admin && S.route === 'admin') render(); }, 4000); render(); break; }
      getPath(p).splice(+i, 1); S.del = null; S.open = null; markDirty(); render(); break;
    }
    case 'clearimg': setField(p, i, b.dataset.f, ''); markDirty(); render(); break;
    case 'save': save(); break;
    case 'setpw': setCreds(); break;
  }
});
document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
  var t = e.target;
  if (t.id === 'pq') {
    var q = t.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    $$('.person').forEach(function (el) { el.hidden = !!q && el.dataset.t.indexOf(q) === -1; });
    return;
  }
  if (t.dataset && t.dataset.f !== undefined && t.dataset.p !== undefined && !t.dataset.img) {
    setField(t.dataset.p, t.dataset.i, t.dataset.f, t.value); markDirty();
    var body = t.closest('.item-body');
    if (body && body.dataset.tk === t.dataset.f) { var ti = body.parentNode.querySelector('.item-title'); if (ti) ti.textContent = t.value.trim() || '(শিরোনামহীন)'; }
  }
});
document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
  var t = e.target;
  if (t.matches && t.matches('input[type=file][data-img]')) {
    var f = t.files && t.files[0]; if (!f) return;
    shrink(f, +t.dataset.w || 1000, t.dataset.fmt).then(function (url) { setField(t.dataset.p, t.dataset.i, t.dataset.f, url); markDirty(); render(); }, function () { toast('ছবিটি পড়া যায়নি। অন্য ছবি চেষ্টা করুন।'); });
  } else if (t.matches && t.matches('input[type=file][data-bulk]')) {
    var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(t.files || []), path = t.dataset.bulk; if (!files.length) return;
    toast('ছবি প্রস্তুত হচ্ছে…', 8000);
    files.reduce(function (pr, file) {
      return pr.then(function () { return shrink(file, 1200, 'image/jpeg').then(function (url) { getPath(path).push({ id: uid(), image: url, caption: '' }); }, function () {}); });
    }, Promise.resolve()).then(function () { markDirty(); render(); toast(bn(files.length) + 'টি ছবি যোগ হয়েছে। এখন "সংরক্ষণ" করুন।'); });
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.enter === 'login') { e.preventDefault(); doLogin(); }
  if (lb) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLB();
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { lb.i = (lb.i - 1 + lb.imgs.length) % lb.imgs.length; drawLB(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { lb.i = (lb.i + 1) % lb.imgs.length; drawLB(); }
  }
});
window.addEventListener('popstate', function () { parseHash(); S.menuOpen = false; S.subOpen = false; render(); });
window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { parseHash(); render(); });

/* ---------- init ---------- */
normalize();
(function () {
  var t = new Date(); S.calY = t.getFullYear(); S.calM = t.getMonth();
  if (ssGet('sch_admin') === '1') S.admin = true;
  var tab = ssGet('sch_tab'); if (tab) S.tab = tab;
  parseHash();
  if (ssGet('sch_return') === '1') { ssDel('sch_return'); if (S.admin) S.route = 'admin'; }
  ARTP = (window.claude && typeof window.claude.use === 'function') ? window.claude.use('artifact').then(function (a) { ART = a || null; ARTP = 'done'; var b = $('#savebtn'); if (b && !S.saving) b.textContent = saveLabel(); }, function () { ARTP = 'done'; }) : 'done';
  render();
  if (ssGet('sch_toast') === '1') { ssDel('sch_toast'); toast('সংরক্ষিত ও প্রকাশিত হয়েছে ✓'); }
})();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
